title: Update indicators refresh without opening release notes
description: The workspace release query refreshes stale update information automatically on load, focus and its existing ten-minute polling interval. The version indicator can discover an available release without being clicked. Checks respect deployment automatic-update preferences, administrator permission, cached freshness and the shared server cooldown. Clicking the version still opens notes, and explicit manual checks remain available.
upgrade: Recreate the web service. Existing deployment update preferences and server background checks are preserved.
